objective: Directly resolve the mechanism, natural fallback and same-information control concerns; target post-rebuttal ratings of332 or333.
task_selection: Prespecified M1 deficit and Mn feedback task, using the two previously qualified simulator implementations, before new policy outcomes.

closed_loop.candidate_null: Force both retrieved-source and retrieved-conditioning gates to zero; retain native episode recollection.
closed_loop.seed_admission: Pinned official expert plan/success check only, shared across roles; preserve every rejected or errored seed and its reason.
closed_loop.instruction: Pinned official unseen descriptions, selected deterministically after reset and verified identical across the pair.
closed_loop.success: Official executor eval_success at the official task step limit; runtime-invalid and interrupted attempts retained separately.
closed_loop.statistics: Paired episode differences, task-specific and fixed-task macro; confidence intervals and discordant counts. No training-seed uncertainty claim.

local_recovery.schedule: Queries encountered on the fixed Full factual trajectory; unavailable ordinals retained as not reached, never replaced according to outcomes.
local_recovery.labels: Task-predicate next-interaction outcomes with sealed definitions and independent traces; no prediction-derived labels.
local_recovery.statistics: Repair, harm, net change and refined-minus-null on shared known-label support, with source-episode clustering.
local_recovery.qualification: Actual WARM history/cursors and exact native-state restoration at every admitted stage before scientific branches.

candidate_specific_effects.qualification: Frozen semantic encoder/projection; common candidate/endpoint support; repeatability tolerances fixed on excluded pilot states.

missing_skill.confidence: One-sided95% conservative paired-risk-difference lower bound, exact Clopper-Pearson gain/harm marginal tails with fixed-task Bonferroni control. Also report two-sided intervals and all discordances.
missing_skill.noninferiority_admission: Only the complete prespecified250-pair-per-task heldout cohort may establish the2pp fixed-task macro margin. Missing/invalid pairs block the conclusion; no inference from zero bootstrap variance.
missing_skill.taxonomy: Annotate task/interaction families before evaluation; distinguish missing terminal skill from retained generic grasp/transport primitives.
missing_skill.coverage_validation: Execute retrieved pools at prespecified diagnostic queries. Task-name removal alone is not evidence of zero relevant-skill coverage.

simple_control.planned_control: Separately trained coarse top1 action prior with the same factual recollection, fixed0.25 source weight, common deterministic start-state warp, and no learned event adaptation, consequence prediction, reranking or confidence gate.
simple_control.implementation: fastwam.research.simple_prior.create_simple_prior; distinct checkpoint schema. Common semantic bridge/gist/recollection and ActionDiT are trained in both arms; removed-module auxiliary losses are zero in the control.
simple_control.matched_reference: New Full and simple-prior runs both start at the identical immutable FastWAM release with fresh optimizers, original30k-step scheduler, and fixed3000-update selection. This new single-GPU cohort does not silently replace the historical4-GPU resumed model.
simple_control.execution: Qualify one GPU memory and update integrity first; checkpoint in bounded restart-safe segments, then allocate the measured budget.
